page_purpose: This page allows users to add a new customer record to their Zoho Books account, capturing essential contact, business, and financial details.
summary: The 'New Customer' page in Zoho Books provides a comprehensive form for creating customer profiles. Users can input contact information, company details, select payment terms, manage accounts receivable settings, and upload documents. It also offers the option to prefill customer data using a GSTIN.
